summary: Independent security review (separate agent, live attacks, real WS, BuildKit experiments) plus an orchestrating-agent pass. Four findings, all fixed and re-verified: HIGH — the image would have shipped the synthetic demo because apps/web/.env was untracked and Vite inlines the variable at build time (fixed by tracking the file, pinning ENV in the Dockerfile, and a new bundle assertion in the docker check; confirmed by A/B build); MEDIUM — the runner wrote synced material with no traversal guard (now resolve+prefix like the server); MEDIUM — the first invited student could land in #teachers (now course-group channels with a student member only, documented); LOW — check:gated shared smoke port 8799 (moved to 8797). Verified-clean list covers allowlist bypasses, timing-safe comparison, token scoping in all four WS combinations, token leakage, a ten-way concurrent invite race, role escalation, static traversal, fail-closed claim, .dockerignore depth and re-seed token preservation. No contradictions with D-001..D-006. Full report in evidence/review.md.
